name: [NEW] Anomaly Cafe
desc:
A Mascot Horror Survival Multiplayer game where you work at Emma's Cafe. Team up with your friends, serve hungry customers, maintain the café but beware! survive the terrifying anomalies that appear when you least expect them.

⭐ Join our group for exclusive in-game rewards!
👁️ Experience original characters, terrifying anomalies, custom music, and more...
👍 Like and follow to support the continued development of Anomaly Cafe!

⚠️This game is in alpha stage. Expect bugs or issues and help us by reporting it in our community server!⚠️

🔔 Join the group for updates! 
https://www.roblox.com/communities/526425480/Anomaly-Cafe

☕ Inspired by Papa Louie game series and Animal Hospital
